title: Implement DDL generation logic
description: Implement DDL (Data Definition Language) generation logic for CREATE TABLE statements, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes based on the diagram model.
acceptanceCriteria: DDL generation produces CREATE TABLE statements
DDL generation produces primary key constraints
DDL generation produces foreign key constraints
Generated DDL is valid PostgreSQL SQL

evidence: backend/src/services/ddl-generator.ts — DDL generation module (CREATE TABLE, composite PK, FK, UNIQUE constraints, CREATE INDEX; quoted identifiers; no destructive statements; tables-first ordering for circular/self-referencing FKs)

backend/src/services/ddl-generator.test.ts — 18 unit tests covering all acceptance criteria (CREATE TABLE, PK single/composite, FK incl. self-referencing/circular, UNIQUE single/composite, indexes plain+unique, reserved words, quoted-identifier escaping, unknown table/column errors, empty diagram, no DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE)

backend/src/__tests__/ddl-generator.integration.test.ts — 7 integration tests against throwaway postgres:16-alpine container on private Docker network; round-trip model->DDL->empty database verified via introspection (types, nullability, defaults, PK, FK self-ref/circular, UNIQUE, indexes)
